title: 2. Give assembly edits successful expert placement traces
hypothesis: Successful expert state-action sequences expose nut-to-peg placement geometry that handoff summaries and parameter-level imitation do not communicate to the symbolic editor.

prediction.rationale: Compare trace-conditioned and summary-only edits of the same recoverable parent under identical search; +0.20 requires actual seating rather than another small progress change.

code_changes: Reuse collect_demos, targeted-edit mode, suites, and rollout_search; add only the trace-payload option and assembly_trace_edit_suite preset with the CLI shown.

Collect five expert episodes on the demonstration manifest. If they do not provide successful placement traces, stop as inconclusive rather than replacing seeds. Extract post-lift observation/action sequences with explicit object, TCP, and goal coordinates; do not include expert source code or evaluation trajectories.

Run two blocks, each containing one summary-only edit and one edit receiving the same summary plus expert traces. Use the frozen recoverable D-020 parent and enforce unchanged pre-lift logic. This differs from D-023 through trajectory evidence, and from D-022 through structural generation rather than fitting.

Each edit receives 24 candidates on its block's five-case probe and paired evaluation on 30 disjoint promotion cases. Report each block's paired interval and the mean fixed-pair difference; do not infer generator-wide reliability from two blocks. Promotion remains subject to the existing strictly positive paired lower bound.

Use seed 3520 for demonstrations, 3521-3524 for edits, 3525-3528 for manifests, and 3529 for search streams. Keep fitting off and pin gpt-6.1-sol/high/temperature=1. No replacement generation calls; require per-idea approval and remote teardown.

falsified_by: Zero success in both trace-conditioned blocks refutes the proposed rescue. Otherwise, an interval whose upper bound is below +0.20 refutes the predicted magnitude; an interval containing zero is inconclusive about an advantage.
